name: 84663 · Springville, UT
findings: ZIP 84663 (Springville) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84663 (Springville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84663 (Springville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.
